name: Arbalist grants ranged attack power equal to 100% of Intellect (#1380)
contract: Arbalist 520851 has E0 aura 212 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT), MiscValue 3 (Intellect), BasePoints 99 / DieSides 1 = 100%; the description reads 'Increases your attack power by $s1% of your Intellect'. Player::UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage adds CalculatePct(Intellect, 100) to ranged attack power for classes that do not use wands (class 15 does not), and Unit::UpdateStats refreshes it when Intellect changes. The scenario applies Arcane Intellect 36880 (E0 aura 29 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, MiscValue 3, BasePoints 99 / DieSides 1 = +100 Intellect), so the ranged attack power must rise by exactly 100 with the passive and not without it. The record is aura 212 (ranged); the melee counterpart is aura 268 which Arbalist does not carry, so the melee attack power is asserted unchanged as a pin of the authored record, not as a claim about the intended scope. Two fixture assumptions are asserted first: the aura adds exactly 100 Intellect (no Intellect percent modifier on a bare level-80 Witch Hunter) and no attack power moves without the passive.

steps.label: Fixture assumption: the aura adds exactly 100 Intellect
Fixture assumption: no ranged attack power without the passive
Ranged attack power with the passive
Melee attack power with the passive
Ranged attack power rises by 100% of the added Intellect
Melee attack power does not follow Intellect
